auth.method: [model_providers.<id>.auth] command in the shared config.toml; printed token sent as Authorization: Bearer
auth.notes: A short refresh_interval_ms gives a fresh token per request; with a long interval or 0, an expired token gets one 401, the helper re-runs and the request is retried. A 401 on a fresh token also re-runs the helper. timeout_ms default 5000 must exceed helper time (15000 used). refresh_interval_ms default 300000. A failing helper runs about 30 times in 25 seconds before failure. Cannot be combined with env_key, experimental_bearer_token or requires_openai_auth. Provider id cannot be openai, ollama or lmstudio. Custom headers via http_headers and env_http_headers; query_params for api-version. The helper runs in the VS Code process environment (az must be on PATH or use the full path). The extension can send an additional /responses request with a model name different from the configured one; the gateway must accept or reject it harmlessly.

model_discovery_endpoint_behaviour: GET <base_url>/models several times; expects {"models": [...]}; mismatch is non-fatal.

config_snippets.content:
model = "<deployment-name>"
model_provider = "apim"
features = { plugins = false, remote_plugin = false, plugin_sharing = false, apps = false, in_app_updates = false }
analytics = { enabled = false }

[model_providers.apim]
name = "Azure APIM"
base_url = "https://<apim-host>/<openai-responses-api-path>"
wire_api = "responses"
# Only if the gateway needs them:
# query_params = { api-version = "<version>" }
# http_headers = { "Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key" = "<subscription-key>" }

[model_providers.apim.auth]
command = "powershell"
args = ["-NoProfile", "-File", 'C:\Users\<you>\bin\get-apim-token.ps1']
timeout_ms = 15000
refresh_interval_ms = 1800000

# Prints ONLY the raw JWT to stdout; on any problem prints a one-line reason to stderr and exits 1.
# Failing fast matters: both Claude Code and Codex retry hard on a bad token.
$Scope       = 'api://<apim-app-id>/.default'
$ExpectedAud = @('api://<apim-app-id>', '<apim-app-client-id>')   # accept both token forms
$MinLifeSecs = 60

$lines = & az account get-access-token --scope $Scope --query accessToken -o tsv 2>$null
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("get-apim-token: az failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE). Run: az login"); exit 1 }

# Tolerate banners/warnings on stdout: keep only the line that looks like a JWT.
$jwt = $lines | ForEach-Object { "$_".Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ -match '^eyJ[\w-]+\.[\w-]+\.[\w-]+$' } | Select-Object -Last 1
if (-not $jwt) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('get-apim-token: az output contained no JWT'); exit 1 }

# Sanity-check the claims so a wrong audience or nearly-expired token fails here, not as an endless 401 loop.
$p = $jwt.Split('.')[1].Replace('-', '+').Replace('_', '/')
while ($p.Length % 4) { $p += '=' }
$claims = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String($p)) | ConvertFrom-Json
$now = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds()
if ($ExpectedAud -notcontains $claims.aud) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("get-apim-token: token aud is '$($claims.aud)', expected '$($ExpectedAud -join "' or '")'"); exit 1 }
if ($claims.exp - $now -lt $MinLifeSecs) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("get-apim-token: token expires in $($claims.exp - $now)s"); exit 1 }

[Console]::Out.Write($jwt)

limits: Plugins, apps and connectors are unavailable; anonymous usage data from the bundled process is off.
The extension still attempts calls to OpenAI hosts and its error reporter; not configurable, harmless when blocked.
A 'Finish Windows setup' sandbox prompt and a model-promotion dialog can appear; unrelated to authentication.
With CODEX_HOME unset, caches and logs are written under %USERPROFILE%\.codex.
The panel can need about 35 seconds before it accepts input.
The extension's own settings documentation page was not available.
Only the Responses wire format is supported for a custom provider.
Model metadata for deployment names is not discovered when the /models shape differs from {"models": [...]}, so generic metadata is used.
Hosted tools (web search, MCP, apps) are not governed by the sandbox network settings.
